Replication of Chen et al. 2023 — AE-Derived Biomarkers in NSCLC Immunotherapy

Published

November 1, 2026

Purpose. This document replicates the key quantitative results reported in Chen et al. (2023), Cancers 15:2521.

Data source. AE.dataA_correct.csv, clin.dataA_correct.csv, AE.dataB_correct.csv, clin.dataB_correct.csv.

Duration convention. All AE duration values use 30-day window-truncated inclusive counting:
pmin(coalesce(time_resolved, 30L), 30L) − time_onset + 1L
(time_resolved = NA for unresolved AEs; capped at the 30-day window boundary)

Show code 
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)

## ── Load correctedData files ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
cd <- "correctedData"

clin_A <- read_csv(file.path(cd, "clin.dataA_correct.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ae_raw_A <- read_csv(file.path(cd, "AE.dataA_correct.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
clin_B <- read_csv(file.path(cd, "clin.dataB_correct.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ae_raw_B <- read_csv(file.path(cd, "AE.dataB_correct.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

## ── Cohort A: survival and AE objects ─────────────────────────────────────────
surv_A <- clin_A |>
  mutate(
    os_time_mo  = os_time  / 30.4375,
    pfs_time_mo = pfs_time / 30.4375,
    os_event    = os_censor,
    pfs_event   = pfs_censor,
    dot_days    = treatment.time,
    response_bin = if_else(response == "Non-PD", "DC", "PD"))

surv_A_dcpd <- surv_A |> filter(!is.na(response_bin))

ae_early_A <- ae_raw_A |>
  filter(!is.na(grade)) |>
  mutate(
    early      = time_onset <= 30,
    trae       = AE_Trt == "Yes",
    low_grade  = grade %in% c(1, 2),
    high_grade = grade >= 3,
    dur_incl   = pmin(coalesce(time_resolved, 30L), 30L) - time_onset + 1L,
    ae_name    = tolower(trimws(toxicity_ind))) |>
  filter(early)

## ── Cohort B: survival and AE objects ─────────────────────────────────────────
surv_B <- clin_B |>
  mutate(
    os_time_mo  = os_time  / 30.4375,
    pfs_time_mo = pfs_time / 30.4375,
    os_event    = os_censor,
    pfs_event   = pfs_censor,
    dot_days    = treatment.time,
    response_bin = if_else(response == "Non-PD", "DC", "PD"))

surv_B_dcpd <- surv_B |> filter(!is.na(response_bin))

ae_early_B <- ae_raw_B |>
  filter(!is.na(grade)) |>
  mutate(
    early      = time_onset <= 30,
    trae       = AE_Trt == "Yes",
    low_grade  = grade %in% c(1, 2),
    high_grade = grade >= 3,
    dur_incl   = pmin(coalesce(time_resolved, 30L), 30L) - time_onset + 1L,

## ── Helper functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

km_stats <- function(fit, sd) {
  med <- summary(fit)$table[, "median"]
  p   <- 1 - pchisq(sd$chisq, df = 1)
  list(med = round(med, 2), p = round(p, 4))
}

match_label <- function(ours, paper, tol = 0.15, pval = FALSE) {
  if (pval) {
    if (is.na(ours) || is.na(paper)) return("⚠ NA")
    ratio <- ours / paper
    if (ratio > 0.5 && ratio < 2.0) "✓ match" else "✗ differs"
  } else {
    if (abs(ours - paper) / max(abs(paper), 0.01) <= tol) "✓ match" else "✗ differs"
  }
}

## ── 24-biomarker builder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build_bio24 <- function(ae_df, surv_df) {
  specs <- tribble(
    ~label,           ~grade_filter, ~trt_only,
    "High_Grade",     "high", FALSE, "High_Grade_Trt", "high", TRUE,
    "Low_Grade",      "low",  FALSE, "Low_Grade_Trt",  "low",  TRUE,
    "Any_Grade",      "any",  FALSE, "Any_Grade_Trt",  "any",  TRUE)
  build_one <- function(label, grade_filter, trt_only) {
    d <- ae_df
    if (grade_filter == "low")  d <- d |> filter(low_grade)
    if (grade_filter == "high") d <- d |> filter(high_grade)
    if (trt_only) d <- d |> filter(trae)
    d |> group_by(id) |>
      summarise(
        !!paste0(label,"_occ")  := 1L,
        !!paste0(label,"_fuq")  := n_distinct(ae_name),
        !!paste0(label,"_fall") := n(),
        !!paste0(label,"_dur")  := sum(dur_incl, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
  }
  bio <- surv_df |> select(id)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(specs)))
    bio <- bio |> left_join(build_one(specs$label[i], specs$grade_filter[i], specs$trt_only[i]),
                             by = "id")
  bio |> mutate(across(-id, ~replace_na(.x, 0)))
}

cox_forest <- function(bio24, surv_df) {
  bio_cols <- setdiff(names(bio24), "id")
  dat <- surv_df |> left_join(bio24, by = "id")
  map_dfr(bio_cols, function(col) {
    tryCatch({
      cx_os  <- summary(coxph(as.formula(paste0("Surv(os_time_mo,os_event)~",col)),   data=dat))$coefficients
      cx_pfs <- summary(coxph(as.formula(paste0("Surv(pfs_time_mo,pfs_event)~",col)), data=dat))$coefficients
      tibble(biomarker=col,
             hr_os=exp(cx_os[1,1]),  p_os=cx_os[1,5],
             hr_pfs=exp(cx_pfs[1,1]),p_pfs=cx_pfs[1,5])
    }, error=function(e) tibble(biomarker=col,hr_os=NA,p_os=NA,hr_pfs=NA,p_pfs=NA))
  }) |>
    mutate(
      category = sub("_(occ|fuq|fall|dur)$","",biomarker),
      measure  = sub(".*_(occ|fuq|fall|dur)$","\\1",biomarker),
      sig_os   = !is.na(p_os)  & p_os  < 0.05,
      sig_pfs  = !is.na(p_pfs) & p_pfs < 0.05)
}

resp_ttest <- function(bio24, surv_dcpd) {
  bio_cols <- setdiff(names(bio24), "id")
  dat <- surv_dcpd |> left_join(bio24, by = "id")
  map_dfr(bio_cols, function(col) {
    x   <- dat[[col]]; grp <- dat$response_bin
    ok  <- !is.na(grp); x <- x[ok]; grp <- grp[ok]
    tt  <- tryCatch(t.test(x ~ grp), error=function(e) NULL)
    tibble(biomarker=col,
           mean_DC = mean(x[grp=="DC"]), mean_PD = mean(x[grp=="PD"]),
           diff    = mean(x[grp=="DC"]) - mean(x[grp=="PD"]),
           p       = if(!is.null(tt)) tt$p.value else NA_real_)
  }) |>
    mutate(
      category = sub("_(occ|fuq|fall|dur)$","",biomarker),
      measure  = sub(".*_(occ|fuq|fall|dur)$","\\1",biomarker),
      sig = !is.na(p) & p < 0.05)
}

## ── AE category/term builder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
grade_lbl <- function(grade, trae) {
  base <- switch(grade, any = "Any grade", low = "Low-Grade", high = "High-Grade")
  if (trae) paste0(base, ".Trt") else base
}

build_bio_g <- function(ae_df, surv_df,
                        tox_cat = NA_character_, ae_term = NA_character_,
                        grade   = "any",         trae    = FALSE) {
  d <- ae_df
  if (!is.na(tox_cat)) d <- filter(d, toxicity_category == tox_cat)
  if (!is.na(ae_term)) d <- filter(d, ae_name == ae_term)
  if (grade == "low")  d <- filter(d, low_grade)
  if (grade == "high") d <- filter(d, high_grade)
  if (trae)            d <- filter(d, trae)
  bio <- d |> group_by(id) |>
    summarise(occ  = 1L,
              fuq  = n_distinct(ae_name),
              fall = n(),
              dur  = sum(dur_incl, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  surv_df |>
    left_join(bio, by = "id") |>
    mutate(across(c(occ, fuq, fall, dur), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
}

run_cox_multi_g <- function(dat) {
  n_pos <- sum(dat$occ); n <- nrow(dat)
  if (n_pos == 0 || n_pos == n)
    return(list(n_pos=n_pos, dir_os="ns", p_os=NA, meas_os=NA_character_,
                             dir_pfs="ns",p_pfs=NA, meas_pfs=NA_character_))
  res <- map_dfr(c("occ","fuq","fall","dur"), function(m) {
    fo  <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(os_time_mo,os_event)~",   m))
    fp  <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(pfs_time_mo,pfs_event)~", m))
    cxo <- tryCatch(coxph(fo, data=dat), error=\(e) NULL)
    cxp <- tryCatch(coxph(fp, data=dat), error=\(e) NULL)
    tibble(m=m,
           hr_os  = if(!is.null(cxo)) exp(coef(cxo)[1])              else NA,
           p_os   = if(!is.null(cxo)) summary(cxo)$coefficients[1,5] else NA,
           hr_pfs = if(!is.null(cxp)) exp(coef(cxp)[1])              else NA,
           p_pfs  = if(!is.null(cxp)) summary(cxp)$coefficients[1,5] else NA)
  })
  bo  <- res |> filter(!is.na(p_os))  |> slice_min(p_os,  n=1, with_ties=FALSE)
  bp  <- res |> filter(!is.na(p_pfs)) |> slice_min(p_pfs, n=1, with_ties=FALSE)
  list(
    n_pos   = n_pos,
    dir_os  = if (nrow(bo)>0 && bo$p_os <0.05) if(bo$hr_os >1)"poorer" else "improved" else "ns",
    p_os    = if (nrow(bo)>0) round(bo$p_os, 4)  else NA,
    meas_os = if (nrow(bo)>0) bo$m               else NA_character_,
    dir_pfs = if (nrow(bp)>0 && bp$p_pfs<0.05) if(bp$hr_pfs>1)"poorer" else "improved" else "ns",
    p_pfs   = if (nrow(bp)>0) round(bp$p_pfs, 4) else NA,
    meas_pfs= if (nrow(bp)>0) bp$m               else NA_character_)
}

run_ttest_multi_g <- function(dat, surv_dcpd) {
  dat2 <- surv_dcpd |>
    left_join(select(dat, id, occ, fuq, fall, dur), by = "id") |>
    filter(!is.na(response_bin))
  if (all(dat2$occ == 0) || all(dat2$occ == 1))
    return(list(n_pos=sum(dat2$occ), dir_resp="ns", p_resp=NA, measure=NA_character_))
  res <- map_dfr(c("occ","fuq","fall","dur"), function(m) {
    tt <- tryCatch(t.test(dat2[[m]] ~ dat2$response_bin), error=\(e) NULL)
    tibble(m=m,
           mean_DC = mean(dat2[[m]][dat2$response_bin=="DC"]),
           mean_PD = mean(dat2[[m]][dat2$response_bin=="PD"]),
           p_resp  = if (!is.null(tt)) tt$p.value else NA_real_)
  }) |> filter(!is.na(p_resp))
  br <- res |> slice_min(p_resp, n=1, with_ties=FALSE)
  list(n_pos    = sum(dat2$occ),
       dir_resp = if (br$p_resp < 0.05) if(br$mean_DC > br$mean_PD)"DC" else "PD" else "ns",
       p_resp   = round(br$p_resp, 4),
       measure  = br$m)
}

run_corr_multi_g <- function(dat) {
  dat2 <- filter(dat, !is.na(dot_days))
  n_pos <- sum(dat2$occ)
  if (n_pos == 0 || sum(dat2$occ == 0) == 0)
    return(list(n_pos=n_pos, dir_corr="ns", p_corr=NA, measure=NA_character_, rho=NA))
  res <- map_dfr(c("occ","fuq","fall","dur"), function(m) {
    ct <- tryCatch(cor.test(dat2[[m]], dat2$dot_days, method="pearson"), error=\(e) NULL)
    tibble(m=m,
           rho    = if(!is.null(ct)) unname(ct$estimate) else NA_real_,
           p_corr = if(!is.null(ct)) ct$p.value          else NA_real_)
  }) |> filter(!is.na(p_corr))
  br <- res |> slice_min(p_corr, n=1, with_ties=FALSE)
  list(n_pos    = n_pos,
       dir_corr = if (br$p_corr < 0.05) if(br$rho > 0)"positive" else "negative" else "ns",
       p_corr   = round(br$p_corr, 4),
       measure  = br$m,
       rho      = round(br$rho, 3))
}

dir_match <- function(ours, paper) {
  if (is.na(paper)) {
    if (ours == "ns") "✓ (ns)" else paste0("⚠ extra: ", ours)
  } else {
    if (ours == paper) "✓" else if (ours == "ns") "✗ (ns)" else paste0("✗ (", ours, ")")
  }
}

batch_cox_g <- function(claims, ae_df, surv_df) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(claims)), function(i) {
    r   <- claims[i, ]
    dat <- build_bio_g(ae_df, surv_df, r$tox_cat, r$ae_term, r$grade, r$trae)
    res <- run_cox_multi_g(dat)
    tibble(Entity    = r$entity_label,
           Biomarker = grade_lbl(r$grade, r$trae),
           n_pos     = res$n_pos,
           Best_meas_OS  = res$meas_os,  p_OS  = res$p_os,
           Best_meas_PFS = res$meas_pfs, p_PFS = res$p_pfs,
           Paper_OS  = r$paper_OS,  Ours_OS  = res$dir_os,
           Paper_PFS = r$paper_PFS, Ours_PFS = res$dir_pfs,
           Match_OS  = dir_match(res$dir_os,  r$paper_OS),
           Match_PFS = dir_match(res$dir_pfs, r$paper_PFS))
  })
}

batch_ttest_g <- function(claims, ae_df, surv_df, surv_dcpd) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(claims)), function(i) {
    r   <- claims[i, ]
    dat <- build_bio_g(ae_df, surv_df, r$tox_cat, r$ae_term, r$grade, r$trae)
    res <- run_ttest_multi_g(dat, surv_dcpd)
    tibble(Entity     = r$entity_label,
           Biomarker  = grade_lbl(r$grade, r$trae),
           n_pos      = res$n_pos,
           Best_meas  = res$measure,
           p_resp     = res$p_resp,
           Paper_resp = r$paper_resp, Ours_resp = res$dir_resp,
           Match      = dir_match(res$dir_resp, r$paper_resp))
  })
}

batch_corr_g <- function(claims, ae_df, surv_df) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(claims)), function(i) {
    r   <- claims[i, ]
    dat <- build_bio_g(ae_df, surv_df, r$tox_cat, r$ae_term, r$grade, r$trae)
    res <- run_corr_multi_g(dat)
    tibble(Entity    = r$entity_label,
           Biomarker = grade_lbl(r$grade, r$trae),
           n_pos     = res$n_pos,
           Best_meas = res$measure,
           Pearson_r = res$rho,
           p_corr    = res$p_corr,
           Paper_DOT = r$paper_DOT, Ours_DOT = res$dir_corr,
           Match     = dir_match(res$dir_corr, r$paper_DOT))
  })
}

Cohort A (n = 32)

3.1.1 Overall AE Level — Survival

NotePaper (§3.1.1 — Survival outcomes)

Patients experienced with early low-grade overall TrAE (n = 22) were associated with longer PFS and OS compared to patients without the experiences (n = 10) (Figure 2A,B: median PFS: 5.7 vs. 1.7 months with p = 0.002; median OS: 10.4 vs. 3.7 months with p = 0.007). A higher frequency and longer duration of early low-grade overall TrAE were also associated with improved PFS (HR < 1 with p < 0.05 in Figure 3A).

Show code 
lg_trae_occ <- ae_early_A |>
  filter(trae, low_grade) |>
  distinct(id) |> mutate(lg_trae = 1L)

df_A_lg <- surv_A |>
  left_join(lg_trae_occ, by = "id") |>
  mutate(lg_trae = replace_na(lg_trae, 0L),
         group   = factor(lg_trae, levels=c(0,1),
                          labels=c("No early LG TrAE","Early LG TrAE")))

fit_pfs_lg <- survfit(Surv(pfs_time_mo, pfs_event) ~ group, data = df_A_lg)
sd_pfs_lg  <- survdiff(Surv(pfs_time_mo, pfs_event) ~ group, data = df_A_lg)
fit_os_lg  <- survfit(Surv(os_time_mo,  os_event)  ~ group, data = df_A_lg)
sd_os_lg   <- survdiff(Surv(os_time_mo,  os_event)  ~ group, data = df_A_lg)

s_pfs_lg <- km_stats(fit_pfs_lg, sd_pfs_lg)
s_os_lg  <- km_stats(fit_os_lg,  sd_os_lg)

n_with    <- sum(df_A_lg$lg_trae)
n_without <- sum(df_A_lg$lg_trae == 0)

Paper (Figure 2A/B): early low-grade overall TrAE, n = 22 with / 10 without; median PFS 5.7 vs 1.7 mo (p = 0.002); median OS 10.4 vs 3.7 mo (p = 0.007).

3.1.1 Overall AE Level — Treatment Response (Figure 2C)

NotePaper (§3.1.1 — Treatment response)

Early low-grade overall TrAE had higher frequency and longer duration in patients with DC (n = 18) compared to patients with PD (n = 12) (mean duration: 26.7 vs. 9.8 days with p = 0.03; mean frequency: 1.6 vs. 0.6 AE events with p = 0.03 in Figures 2C and 3B). On the other hand, patients with PD showed more experience or longer duration of early high-grade overall TrAE (p < 0.05; Figure 3B and Figure S3C). Note: the statistically significant result is from high-grade overall AE (occurrence p = 0.012, duration p = 0.037), not the TrAE-restricted variant (occurrence p = 0.34, ns). The “TrAE” label in the paper is inconsistent with the data. Early high-grade overall TrAE was also correlated with shorter treatment duration (Table S8).

Show code 
lg_trae_summ <- ae_early_A |>
  filter(trae, low_grade) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(duration_sum = sum(dur_incl, na.rm=TRUE),
            freq_all     = n(), .groups="drop")

df_2c <- surv_A_dcpd |>
  left_join(lg_trae_summ, by = "id") |>
  mutate(duration_sum = replace_na(duration_sum, 0),
         freq_all     = replace_na(freq_all, 0L))

means_2c <- df_2c |> group_by(response_bin) |>
  summarise(dur = round(mean(duration_sum),2),
            freq = round(mean(freq_all),2), .groups="drop")
tt_dur  <- t.test(duration_sum ~ response_bin, data = df_2c)
tt_freq <- t.test(freq_all     ~ response_bin, data = df_2c)

3.1.1 Overall AE Level — 24-Biomarker Summary (Figure 3)

NotePaper (§3.1.1 — Figure 3 summary)

(A) OS and PFS: The treatment-related low-grade AE category had all four measurement types of AE associated with improved PFS (HR < 1) and the occurrence event associated with improved OS. In contrast, the high-grade AE category had all four measurement types of AE associated with poorer survival (OS and PFS; HR > 1).

(B) Treatment response: The treatment-related low-grade AE category had AE frequency and duration associated with DC (DC−PD > 0).

3.1.1 Supplementary Figure S3 — High-grade AE

NotePaper (§3.1.1 — High-grade AE, Figure S3)

Patients experienced with early high-grade overall AE (n = 9) had shorter PFS and OS compared to the ones without the experiences (n = 23) (Figure S3A,B: median PFS: 1.5 vs. 4.6 months with p = 0.0003; median OS: 2.7 vs. 8.8 months with p = 0.0002). Patients with PD showed more experience or longer duration of early high-grade overall TrAE (p < 0.05; Figure 3B and Figure S3C). Note: significant result is from high-grade overall AE (occurrence p = 0.012, duration p = 0.037), not the TrAE-restricted variant (occurrence p = 0.34, ns).

Show code 
ae_flag_surv <- function(ae_nm, grade_filter="low", trae_only=FALSE, ae_df, surv_df) {
  d <- ae_df |> filter(ae_name == ae_nm)
  if (grade_filter=="low")  d <- d |> filter(low_grade)
  if (grade_filter=="high") d <- d |> filter(high_grade)
  if (trae_only) d <- d |> filter(trae)
  pts <- d |> distinct(id) |> mutate(ae_flag=1L)
  surv_df |> left_join(pts, by="id") |>
    mutate(ae_flag=replace_na(ae_flag,0L),
           group=factor(ae_flag,levels=c(0,1),
                        labels=c(paste0("No ",ae_nm), ae_nm)))
}

sd_hypo  <- survdiff(Surv(pfs_time_mo,pfs_event)~group, data=df_hypo)
s_hypo   <- km_stats(fit_hypo, sd_hypo)

ae_dur_dcpd <- function(ae_nm, grade_filter="low", trae_only=FALSE) {
  d <- ae_early_A |> filter(ae_name == ae_nm)
  if (grade_filter=="low")  d <- d |> filter(low_grade)
  if (grade_filter=="high") d <- d |> filter(high_grade)
  if (trae_only) d <- d |> filter(trae)
  dur_pt <- d |> group_by(id) |>
    summarise(total_dur=sum(dur_incl, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
  surv_A_dcpd |>
    left_join(dur_pt, by="id") |>
    mutate(total_dur=replace_na(total_dur, 0))
}

df_fat  <- ae_dur_dcpd("fatigue",                  "low", FALSE)
df_pain <- ae_dur_dcpd("pain",                     "low", FALSE)
df_plat <- ae_dur_dcpd("platelet count decreased", "low", TRUE)

tt_fat  <- t.test(total_dur ~ response_bin, data=df_fat)
tt_pain <- t.test(total_dur ~ response_bin, data=df_pain)
tt_plat <- t.test(total_dur ~ response_bin, data=df_plat)

means_fat  <- df_fat  |> group_by(response_bin) |> summarise(m=round(mean(total_dur),2),.groups="drop")
means_pain <- df_pain |> group_by(response_bin) |> summarise(m=round(mean(total_dur),2),.groups="drop")
means_plat <- df_plat |> group_by(response_bin) |> summarise(m=round(mean(total_dur),2),.groups="drop")

  `n with AE` = c(sum(df_fat$total_dur>0), sum(df_pain$total_dur>0), sum(df_plat$total_dur>0)),
  `DC mean (days)` = c(means_fat$m[means_fat$response_bin=="DC"],
                       means_pain$m[means_pain$response_bin=="DC"],
                       means_plat$m[means_plat$response_bin=="DC"]),
  `PD mean (days)` = c(means_fat$m[means_fat$response_bin=="PD"],
                       means_pain$m[means_pain$response_bin=="PD"],
                       means_plat$m[means_plat$response_bin=="PD"]),
  `p (two-sided)` = round(c(tt_fat$p.value, tt_pain$p.value, tt_plat$p.value), 4),
  `Paper claim` = c("p<0.05 DC>PD", "p<0.05 DC>PD", "p<0.05 DC>PD (n=5)"),

            if_else(tt_pain$p.value < 0.05, "✓ match", "⚠ borderline"),
            if_else(tt_plat$p.value < 0.05, "✓ match", "✗ differs"))

NotePaper (§3.2.1 — Treatment response)

Patients with DC had a longer duration of early low-grade overall AE compared to patients with PD development (Figures 5C and 6B). Note: the statistically significant result is from LG TrAE duration (p ≈ 0.024 ≈ paper p = 0.02), not LG overall AE duration (p = 0.80, ns). The “overall AE” label in the paper text is inconsistent with Figures 5C/6B, which display the TrAE-restricted biomarker.

p_flag <- function(p) if_else(p < 0.05, "✓", if_else(p < 0.10, "(b)", "✗"))

flag_fmt <- function(p, hr) {
  sym <- if_else(p < 0.05, "**✓**",
           if_else(p < 0.10, "*(b)*", ""))
  dir <- if_else(hr > 1, "↑", "↓")
  paste0(sym, " ", dir, " p=", formatC(p, format="f", digits=3))
}

cox_B |>
  mutate(
    OS  = flag_fmt(p_os,  hr_os),
    PFS = flag_fmt(p_pfs, hr_pfs),
    Category = factor(category, levels=category_order),
    Measure  = factor(measure, levels=c("occ","fuq","fall","dur"),
                      labels=c("Occurrence","Freq Unique","Freq All","Duration"))
  ) |>
  arrange(Category, Measure) |>
  select(Category, Measure, OS, PFS) |>
  knitr::kable()

df_GI <- surv_B |>
  left_join(gi_occ_B, by="id") |>
  mutate(gi=replace_na(gi,0L),
         group=factor(gi,levels=c(0,1),labels=c("No early GI AE","Early GI AE")))

n_gi_with    <- sum(df_GI$gi)
n_gi_without <- sum(df_GI$gi == 0)

fit_pfs_GI <- survfit(Surv(pfs_time_mo,pfs_event)~group, data=df_GI)
sd_pfs_GI  <- survdiff(Surv(pfs_time_mo,pfs_event)~group, data=df_GI)
fit_os_GI  <- survfit(Surv(os_time_mo,os_event)~group,   data=df_GI)
sd_os_GI   <- survdiff(Surv(os_time_mo,os_event)~group,  data=df_GI)
s_pfs_GI <- km_stats(fit_pfs_GI, sd_pfs_GI)
s_os_GI  <- km_stats(fit_os_GI,  sd_os_GI)

Paper (Figure 7A / §3.2.2): LG GI disorders; n = 31 with / 19 without; PFS 3.97 vs 2.77 mo; OS 9.9 vs 4.43 mo (log-rank p < 0.05 for both).

Show code 
tribble(
  ~Outcome, ~`n (with/without)`,
            ~`Paper median (with/without, mo)`,
            ~`Ours median (with/without, mo)`,
            ~`Ours p`, ~Match,
  "PFS", paste0(n_gi_with,"/",n_gi_without), "3.97 / 2.77",
         paste(s_pfs_GI$med[2], "vs", s_pfs_GI$med[1]),
         s_pfs_GI$p, match_label(s_pfs_GI$med[2], 3.97),
  "OS",  paste0(n_gi_with,"/",n_gi_without), "9.9 / 4.43",
         paste(s_os_GI$med[2], "vs", s_os_GI$med[1]),
         s_os_GI$p, match_label(s_os_GI$med[2], 9.9)
)

Figure 7B — Treatment Response

Show code 
gi_bio_resp <- ae_early_B |>
  filter(toxicity_category == "Gastrointestinal disorders", low_grade, trae) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(gi_occ=1L, gi_fuq=n_distinct(ae_name),
            gi_fall=n(), gi_dur=sum(dur_incl,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

nausea_bio_resp <- ae_early_B |>
  filter(ae_name == "nausea", low_grade, trae) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(nausea_occ=1L, nausea_fuq=n_distinct(ae_name),
            nausea_fall=n(), nausea_dur=sum(dur_incl,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

df_7b <- surv_B_dcpd |>
  left_join(gi_bio_resp,     by="id") |>
  left_join(nausea_bio_resp, by="id") |>
  mutate(across(c(gi_occ,gi_fuq,gi_fall,gi_dur,
                  nausea_occ,nausea_fuq,nausea_fall,nausea_dur), ~replace_na(.x,0L)))

best_p <- function(df, prefix) {
  map_dfr(c("occ","fuq","fall","dur"), function(m) {
    col <- paste0(prefix,"_",m)
    tt  <- tryCatch(t.test(df[[col]] ~ df$response_bin), error=\(e) NULL)
    tibble(measure=m,
           mean_DC=mean(df[[col]][df$response_bin=="DC"]),
           mean_PD=mean(df[[col]][df$response_bin=="PD"]),
           p=if(!is.null(tt)) tt$p.value else NA_real_)
  }) |> arrange(p)
}

gi_resp     <- best_p(df_7b, "gi")
nausea_resp <- best_p(df_7b, "nausea")
gi_best     <- gi_resp     |> slice(1)
nausea_best <- nausea_resp |> slice(1)
Show code 
tribble(
  ~Entity, ~`Best measure`, ~`DC mean`, ~`PD mean`, ~p, ~`Paper claim`, ~Match,
  "GI disorders LG",
    gi_best$measure, round(gi_best$mean_DC,2), round(gi_best$mean_PD,2),
    round(gi_best$p,4), "DC", if_else(gi_best$p<0.05,"✓","✗ (ns)"),
  "Nausea LG",
    nausea_best$measure, round(nausea_best$mean_DC,2), round(nausea_best$mean_PD,2),
    round(nausea_best$p,4), "DC", if_else(nausea_best$p<0.05,"✓","✗ (ns)")
)

Supplementary Tables S6–S8 (Cohort A — AE Category/Term Level)

Supplementary Tables S6, S7, and S8 report statistically significant associations between AE category- and term-level biomarkers and survival (S6), treatment response (S7), and duration of treatment/DOT (S8) for Cohort A. These tables contain no effect sizes or exact p-values — only direction flags. Replication checks whether our computed direction and significance (p < 0.05) agree with each paper entry.

NoteNotes on discrepancies

  1. Duration formula: pmin(coalesce(time_resolved, 30L), 30L) − time_onset + 1L (30-day window-truncated, inclusive). Equivalent to the raw-data formula min(Resolved Date, On-Treatment-Date + 30) − Onset Date + 1. The +1 is required for exact mean matches (Fig 2C: DC 26.67 vs PD 9.75 days).

  2. TrAE-label / overall-AE caption ambiguity (Figures 3B, S3C, Cohort B parallel panels): The paper uses the “TrAE” label in captions for results that derive from the high-grade overall AE category. The overall variant is the one reaching p < 0.05 in all three cases.

  3. S6–S11 non-matches: Cohort A is fully reproduced (S6: 31/31 OS, 44/44 PFS; S7: 12/12; S8: 27/27 — all perfect). Cohort B: S9 OS 38/43 (88%), S9 PFS 25/32 (78%) — remaining non-matches are irreducible borderline p-values (0.05–0.13); Psychiatric disorders category (p≈0.65, unresolved). S10: 7/10; S11: 12/12 ✓.

Discussion

§4.1 Cohort A Claims

NotePaper (§4.1 — Cohort A)

The median survival time was more than double in patients with AE experience compared to the ones without AE event experience (Figures 2A and 4A).

For treatment response, platelet count decreased had Vorinostat treatment related low-grade AE associated with DC. The early AE event occurred in five SD patients with a duration ranging from 3 to 11 days, but not in PD patients. The relevant early low-grade TrAEs associated with longer treatment duration included hypothyroidism (n = 3) and vomiting (n = 3).

Specifically, patients with early high-grade overall TrAEs had shorter PFS and were associated with PD. Note: the significant result for shorter PFS is from high-grade overall AE (all 4 measures HR > 1, p < 0.05 in Figure 3A); the TrAE-restricted variant is not significant for PFS.

We further analyzed the association in Cohort A between low- versus high-grade overall AE and found ten patients without experiences of early low-grade overall TrAE and six patients (60%) with early high-grade overall AE, compared to 22 patients experiencing early low-grade overall TrAE with only six patients (14%) with early high-grade overall AE, including one patient with early high-grade overall TrAE (p = 0.12 by Fisher exact test). Note: compound error — the count “six” in the LG TrAE group is inconsistent with the stated 14% (6/22 = 27%, not 14%) and Figure S3 (total n = 9; 6 + 6 = 12 ≠ 9). The correct count is three (3/22 = 13.6% ≈ 14%, giving 6 + 3 = 9 ✓). With three, Fisher exact p = 0.013 (significant), contradicting the stated “insignificant” conclusion.

Show code 
tabA <- matrix(c(6, 6, 4, 16), nrow = 2, byrow = FALSE,
               dimnames = list(c("No LG TrAE (n=10)", "LG TrAE (n=22)"),
                               c("HG AE", "No HG AE")))
pA <- fisher.test(tabA)$p.value

tabB <- matrix(c(6, 3, 4, 19), nrow = 2, byrow = FALSE,
               dimnames = list(c("No LG TrAE (n=10)", "LG TrAE (n=22)"),
                               c("HG AE", "No HG AE")))
pB <- fisher.test(tabB)$p.value

tribble(
  ~Scenario, ~`No LG TrAE: HG (n)`, ~`LG TrAE: HG (n)`, ~`% in LG TrAE`,
             ~`Total HG AE`, ~`Fig S3 n=9`, ~`Fisher p`, ~`Paper p=0.12`,
  "A — paper as written ('six')",
    "6/10 (60%)", "6/22", "27.3%",
    as.character(6L+6L), "✗ 12≠9",
    round(pA, 4), match_label(pA, 0.12, pval = TRUE),
  "B — corrected ('three')",
    "6/10 (60%)", "3/22", "13.6% ≈ 14% ✓",
    as.character(6L+3L), "✓ 9=9",
    round(pB, 4), match_label(pB, 0.12, pval = TRUE)
)

§4.1 Cohort B Claims

NotePaper (§4.1 — Cohort B)

In Cohort B, early low-grade TrAEs associated with positive clinical outcomes were gastrointestinal disorders and the member, nausea. Patients with DC (n = 25) tended to have longer AE duration compared to PD patients (n = 20). In addition, early low-grade overall AE yielded better OS and PFS and was associated with DC. Other low-grade AEs associated with better clinical outcomes included gastrointestinal disorders and nausea with improved PFS, and anemia, constipation, flatulence, rash maculo-papular with longer treatment duration. On the other hand, early AEs associated with negative survival outcomes included high-grade overall AE, three toxicity categories and five related individual AEs in high-grade AE level, and four toxicity categories and ten individual AEs in low-grade AE level. Note: these counts are not fully reproducible — our reconstruction matches 38/43 OS (88%) and 25/32 PFS (78%). Several specific entries are borderline or unresolved (see S9 analysis: anorexia OS p=0.053 confirmed irreducible; psychiatric disorders p≈0.65 unresolved).
